title: A retract of a zero object is zero
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category with zero morphisms (for instance an abelian category), $X,Y$ objects of $\mathcal C$ and $\iota:X\to Y$, $\rho:Y\to X$ morphisms with $\rho\circ\iota=\mathrm{id}_X$. If $Y$ is a zero object, then $X$ is a zero object. (Proof: $\iota$ factors through the zero object $Y$, so $\iota=0$ and $\mathrm{id}_X=\rho\circ\iota=0$, hence every morphism into or out of $X$ is $0$.)
